notes.manas-2010:p0718:b001:l005: Тулпар heroic steed conventionally winged; no literal winged anatomy added elsewhere. Буудан distinguished as racer.
notes.manas-2010:p0718:b001:l008: Repeated heating formula at l011 intentionally retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0718:b001:l010: Өң all/thoroughbred horses; exact attributive force provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0718:b001:l015: Көмөкөй throat/deep mouth; not correcting anatomical hyperbole of bits.
notes.manas-2010:p0718:b001:l019: Чыңыроон signal trumpet, edition glossary1843:l039 and Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/чы/. Not silence or snoring.
notes.manas-2010:p0718:b001:l025: Clause allocation retained: Manas epithet in l025, birth for his fortune in l026.
notes.manas-2010:p0718:b001:l033: Horse/genitive phrase and wrestling at its mouth remain on their own lines. Reins supplied riding idiom.
notes.manas-2010:p0718:b001:l040: Bötönchü capitalized as source; no inferred modern location.
notes.manas-2010:p0719:b001:l002: Early word becoming late conveys impatience; temporal paradox retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0719:b001:l005: Түгөнүшүп finish each other/fight to end, mortal stakes but outcome not invented.
notes.manas-2010:p0719:b001:l006: Two eyes become four, idiom of eager waiting/longing, not anatomical multiplication.
notes.manas-2010:p0719:b001:l009: Attention directed to Manas reading provisional; literal seeing/attention clause retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0719:b001:l014: Сары изине чөп салуу relentless pursuit, Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/чөп/ and 2015 phraseological dictionary https://el-sozduk.kg/sary-izine-chop-saluu/. No literal grass ritual.
notes.manas-2010:p0719:b001:l017: Source explicitly identifies Kum-Aryk as river Lob; not modern geographic verification.
notes.manas-2010:p0719:b001:l021: Мамындай thus/like this, Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/мамы/ gives exact folktale deictic sense; not мамы hitching post.
notes.manas-2010:p0719:b001:l024: Супа садык first dawn, same edition glossary1842:l030.
notes.manas-2010:p0719:b001:l027: Bakai follows preceding route; agent of кеткен inferred pursued party.
notes.manas-2010:p0719:b001:l030: Jangyryk and Jar-Kyya retained as printed toponyms; exact relation provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0719:b001:l034: Сайроо shallow/fordable river reach, Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/САЙРОО/. Not birdsong.
notes.manas-2010:p0719:b001:l035: Кыр raised ground/edge modifying ford, exact local morphology provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0719:b001:l037: Маш кечүү convenient ford exact Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/mash-4/. Not person Mash.
notes.manas-2010:p0720:b001:l008: Mountain name and descending hollow remain respectively l008 and l009.
notes.manas-2010:p0720:b001:l011: Swine is narratorial hostile epithet for Alööke, retained as epic voice.
notes.manas-2010:p0720:b001:l013: Өрүүн resting halt for a day, not permanent settlement.
notes.manas-2010:p0720:b001:l019: Signal trumpet as at718:l019, juxtaposition with rest preserved.
notes.manas-2010:p0720:b001:l020: Printed mule with foal retained despite biological improbability; no silent mare substitution.
notes.manas-2010:p0720:b001:l021: Printed бой кылып, not той кылып. Бой alone sense Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/бой/ supports leaving mother alone after slaughtering foal; provisional object assignment. Feast interpretation rejected as requiring unverified spelling change.
notes.manas-2010:p0720:b001:l024: Torghut/Manchu groups in epic narrative; mighty men rendering дөөлөр.
notes.manas-2010:p0720:b001:l026: Quoted anticipation subordinated to next-line untroubled negation, not asserting they expected an attack.
notes.manas-2010:p0720:b001:l030: Burut historical exonym for Kyrgyz retained; not a new people invented.
notes.manas-2010:p0720:b001:l033: Куралы his weapons/equipment; predicative beasts as war equipment inferred from no ordinary horses and iron hooves context. Dictionary https://el-sozduk.kg/курал/.
notes.manas-2010:p0720:b001:l035: Cast iron hooves epic hyperbole, not an added explanation of horseshoes.
notes.manas-2010:p0720:b001:l038: Eighteen thousand worlds is cosmological hyperbole; exact number preserved.
notes.manas-2010:p0720:b001:l042: Илек broad vast host sense, no fabricated exact troop census; conditional continues next page.
